missing.title: Plugin not installed
missing.description: No plugin with this id is installed on this instance.

overview.title: Overview
overview.off-bundled: Off, nobody can open it. Its data stays.
overview.off-service: Off, its service scales to zero. Its data and settings stay.

access.title: Who can use it
access.intro: Admins can always manage it. Members see it in their sidebar only when it is for everyone.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: What this plugin lets you change. Changes save as you make them; a field left empty uses its default.

egress.title: Outbound network
egress.intro: The hosts outside Socio its settings allow its service to reach, over HTTPS. A host from a setting reaches the service once the settings apply.
egress.intro-none: Its settings allow its service nothing outside Socio, once they apply.
egress.pending: From the settings just saved. Until they apply, the running service keeps the hosts it had.
egress.problem: No host added from {{field}}: {{problem}}. Set it to an https address to allow its host.

datasets.title: Datasets
datasets.intro: The workspace datasets it reads or writes, and how many data operations it may make a minute. Each dataset has one plugin that writes it; a read need may stay unbound. Uninstalling keeps them.

budget.label: Data operations a minute
budget.default: The workspace’s default for plugins, {{limit, number}}, set in Settings → General → Plugin datasets.
budget.override: Set for this plugin; the workspace’s default is {{limit, number}}.
budget.counts: A query or a read batch counts as one, a write batch as one per statement. Socios and people keep their own limit.
budget.load-failed: Could not load the plugin’s data budget.
budget.save-failed: Could not save the data budget.
budget.reset: It uses the workspace’s default again.

backup.none-yet: It has no good backup yet.
backup.ok: Its own storage ({{volumes, list(type: unit; style: short)}}) is backed up with every scheduled backup. {{last}}
backup.stale: Its own storage ({{volumes, list(type: unit; style: short)}}) hasn’t been backed up for more than two backup intervals. {{last}}
backup.disabled: It is disabled, so it isn’t backed up; its backups stay. {{last}}
backup.disabled_since: It is disabled since {{when}}, so it isn’t backed up; its backups stay. {{last}}
backup.first: It keeps data on its own storage ({{volumes, list(type: unit; style: short)}}) and declares backups. Its first backup comes with the next scheduled backup, or use Back up now.
backup.undeclared: It keeps data on its own storage ({{volumes, list(type: unit; style: short)}}), and the installed version doesn’t declare backups, so the workspace’s backups don’t include it. Once its catalog entry declares service.backup, apply its Update. A later release refuses to install or update it without one.

backups.title: Backups
backups.intro: The workspace backs up this plugin’s own storage with every scheduled backup, sealed under the data key, and off-site with the rest.
backups.load-failed: Could not load the plugin’s backups.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.intro: Uninstalling can’t be undone from here. Installing it again starts with default settings.
danger.uninstall-bundled: Removes it from this instance. Rows it saved stay, and its datasets stay the workspace’s.
danger.uninstall-service: Removes its service, volumes and identity. Rows it saved stay, and its datasets stay the workspace’s.
